components.name: Studio primary button
components.description: The main save or create action.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.6rem; min-height:46px; border:1px solid #3c5bdf; border-radius:8px; padding:.65rem 1rem; font:600 .875rem/1.6 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; color:white; background:#3c5bdf; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#4a68ea; border-color:#4a68ea; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f6a5eb; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Studio secondary button
components.description: A supporting action such as choosing images or unpublishing.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:46px; border:1px solid #2c3950; border-radius:8px; padding:.65rem 1rem; font:600 .875rem/1.6 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; color:var(--color-text,#f7f8ff); background:#0c182b; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#1a2a43; border-color:#67748d; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f6a5eb; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-secondary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Studio danger button
components.description: Explicit destructive action, separated from normal saves.
components.css: .ds-danger { min-height:46px; border:1px solid #854b59; border-radius:8px; padding:.65rem 1rem; font:600 .875rem/1.6 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; color:#ffc0c8; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; transition:background 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background:#45222f; } .ds-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f6a5eb; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-danger:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-danger { transition:none; } }

components.name: Studio input
components.description: Visible label and a dark editable field.
components.css: .ds-label { display:grid; gap:.55rem; color:var(--color-text,#f7f8ff); font:600 .8125rem/1.6 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height:46px; min-width:0; border:1px solid #2c3950; border-radius:8px; padding:.75rem .85rem; color:var(--color-text,#f7f8ff); background:#081426; font:400 .875rem/1.6 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; caret-color:var(--color-pink,#e567d7); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--color-pink,#e567d7); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#9baac1; opacity:1; }

components.name: Studio navigation
components.description: Current artwork location and a secondary public-site destination.
components.html: ArtworkView website
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:1.5rem; font:.875rem/1.6 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:#b4bfd2; text-decoration:none; transition:background 160ms ease,border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav .ds-current { color:white; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #f6a5eb; outline-offset:4px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-nav a { transition:none; } }

components.name: Visibility badges
components.description: Noninteractive text and dot identify draft and published states.
components.css: .ds-badges { display:flex; gap:.75rem; } .ds-status { display:inline-flex; gap:.4rem; align-items:center; width:fit-content; padding:.25rem .65rem; color:#e1e5f0; border:1px solid #56617a; border-radius:5px; background:#172239; font:600 .6875rem/1.6 'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-status::before { content:''; width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; } .ds-published { color:#a7efcb; background:#12322b; border-color:#356b57; }

narrative.overview:
The private dashboard extends the existing HUX identity: deep navy, Plus Jakarta Sans, pale text, and violet and pink accents. Its character is quiet and practical. Artwork remains the visual subject; controls and metadata establish order around it.

This document records the finished dashboard and the shared tokens it inherits. The public portfolio keeps its existing composition, artwork, glass treatments, gradients, and more expressive display typography. Dashboard rules below are scoped to private administration and do not prescribe a redesign of that public surface. Evidence is `src/index.css`, `src/components/auth/Auth.css`, and `src/components/dashboard/Dashboard.css` with the corresponding dashboard components. Review captures are in `.impeccable/review/`; they are QA artifacts, not shipped artwork assets.
keyCharacteristics: Shared navy identity with a quieter private workspace.
Image-led library and uncropped artwork previews.
Flat, bordered controls and clear text labels.
Persistent save actions and explicit publication states.

rules.name: The Surface Scope Rule
rules.body: Preserve the shared identity tokens while applying flat studio materials only to private administration.

rules.name: The Operational Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep the page title, section titles, field labels, and helper text visibly distinct without borrowing the public hero scale.

rules.name: The Flat Studio Rule
rules.body: Establish dashboard grouping with spacing, borders, and solid tone before adding depth effects.

dos: Do preserve the public portfolio's existing identity, composition, and local artwork.
Do show complete artwork inside contained preview frames.
Do keep draft, published, loading, empty, error, and saving states explicit in text.
Do keep labels, visible keyboard focus, and reachable save actions on narrow screens.
Do use the dashboard's flat studio surfaces for private administration.
donts: Don't export dashboard density or flatness rules into a public portfolio redesign.
Don't add decorative glass, gradients, metrics, or invented client content to the dashboard.
Don't turn the public surface's existing eyebrow/kicker treatments into a reusable typography rule; those inherited exceptions are not canonized here.
Don't treat review fixtures or QA screenshots as application content or shipped assets.
